# Dashmesh Culture Centre

> A Calgary-based Sikh cultural and community organization providing spiritual guidance, education, and humanitarian services rooted in the principles of selfless service.

Founded in 1987, Dashmesh Culture Centre serves the Calgary Sikh community through religious programs, educational initiatives, and social welfare projects. The organization operates a Gurdwara (Sikh temple), Khalsa School, and multiple community development initiatives including food security, housing support, and cultural celebrations.

## Key Topics

- Dashmesh Culture Centre
- Gurdwara Sahib
- Khalsa School
- Nagar Kirtan
- Gurmat (Sikh Philosophy)
- Khalsa (Sikh Order)
- Calgary Sikh Community
- Kirtan (Devotional Singing)
- Community Langar (Food Service)
- Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji
- Selfless Service (Seva)
- Food Security Projects
- Transitional Housing
- Cultural Education
- Facility Development

## About & Leadership

- [About](https://www.dashmesh.ca/about): About page detailing Dashmesh Culture Centre's mission, vision, and community history.
- [Dashmesh Culture Centre - Selfless Service in Remembrance of God](https://www.dashmesh.ca): Homepage for Dashmesh Culture Centre, a Calgary Sikh community cultural center founded in 1987.
- [Team](https://www.dashmesh.ca/team): Leadership team and board of trustees directory for Dashmesh Culture Centre.

## Spiritual Programs & Worship

- [Daily Schedule](https://www.dashmesh.ca/daily-schedule): Daily worship schedule including Kirtan, Katha, and spiritual programs at the Gurdwara.
- [Gurmat Classes](https://www.dashmesh.ca/gurmat-classes): Gurmat classes offering Sikh education, Punjabi language, martial arts, and music training.
- [Nagar Kirtan 2026](https://www.dashmesh.ca/nagar-kirtan-2026): Information about the 2026 Nagar Kirtan procession celebrating Khalsa birth and Vaisakhi.

## Community Services & Projects

- [Projects](https://www.dashmesh.ca/services): Overview of Dashmesh Culture Centre's community services and religious programs.
- [Food Security Projects](https://www.dashmesh.ca/projects/food-security-projects): Food security initiatives including No Hungry Tummy and community langar programs.
- [Woman and Children's Transitional Housing](https://www.dashmesh.ca/projects/woman-and-childrens-transitional-housing): Transitional housing project in Saddleridge for women and children in need.
- [Community Garden](https://www.dashmesh.ca/projects/community-garden): Community garden project featuring vegetable growing and outdoor beautification.

## Facility Development & Infrastructure

- [Gurdwara Sahib Expansion](https://www.dashmesh.ca/projects/gurdwara-sahib-expansion): Gurdwara Sahib expansion and renovation project in Calgary with fundraising efforts.
- [New Gurdwara Site](https://www.dashmesh.ca/projects/new-gurdwara-site): New Gurdwara construction project in Stonegate, northeast Calgary near Stoney Trail.
- [Khalsa School Expansion](https://www.dashmesh.ca/projects/khalsa-school-expansion): Khalsa School expansion project adding high school classrooms and facilities.
- [Khalsa School Athletic Grounds](https://www.dashmesh.ca/projects/khalsa-school-athletic-grounds): Athletic grounds development including track and field facilities for Khalsa School.
